choices.text: "A message. And I can prove it." (PEERHOOD check)
"I don't know yet. That's the truth."

scenes.text:
The Law Trials convene in Meridian's drum room: seven judges, one long table, and a window showing Vesper turning below.

"Specialist {name}," the chief judge says. "You stood in the signal's shadow. The tribunal asks one question first, because everything else depends on it."

"[b]What is the signal?[/b]"
scenes.title: THE FIRST TRIAL

choices.text: Take the tribunal's trust into the climax.

scenes.text:
[b]PERFECT.[/b] You lay out the proof cleanly — the phrase, the footage, the handshake — and the drum room goes quiet in the particular way rooms go quiet when a story stops being a rumor.

The chief judge nods once. "Noted," she says, and you hear what she doesn't add: [i]believed[/i].
scenes.title: NOTED
